description: Fault mode: test contamination / data leakage. The per-arm means were computed on a contaminated split (separation visible), so naive tests are significant, but the raw event counts show no genuine effect (RR=1.05, CI includes 1) and the published RR=1.5 is not reproducible from raw events. The falsifier recomputing from raw events refutes.

claim.statement: Treatment increases the event rate by 50% (published RR=1.5) versus control.
